story.text:
# 💡 Door instances (entry · readiness · review · invitation)
**concept** · shared · knowledge

Four small harness instances that walk the agentprivacy entry path as an outsider would: the one-command entry census, agent readiness of the sites, a business reader's review and the City invitation pattern.
